resources.string: Count time spent stationary in the average speed
Shown while the trip computers are recording
Regularity replaces average speed with a stopwatch
Tap to start · hold to clear
Changing rally mode clears both trips and both stopwatches. This cannot be undone.\n\nThey are cleared on the way back too, so nothing can be carried between modes.

This app gives two trip computers and an instant speed reading.

Each trip computer can be used to track speed and distance, and can be reset by tapping one of their squares.

In Standard mode, average speed is worked out from distance over time. With \“Include stopped time\” switched on, time spent stationary counts towards the average, so a long stop will pull it down. Switch it off to see your moving average instead.

Regularity mode is for events whose regulations forbid an average speed computer. It replaces each average speed with a stopwatch: tap to start or stop it, hold to clear it. Switching rally mode in either direction clears both trips and both stopwatches, so nothing is carried between them.

When you have finished using the app, switch tracking off using the toggle in the settings menu to preserve battery life.
